title: Nicer Than Expected
text: Nicer Than Expected. This seasonal sign decor set is nicer than I expected. The pieces can be used with the larger one as there is a spot for it to go, or individually. Stands are included. They look very nice in person and don't have that mass produced look to them. I plan to use them with my tiered tray.  I am pleasantly surprised by these.

product_metadata.title: Houmury Farmhouse Home Decor Season Sign Interchangeable Home Sweet Home Round Shiplap Sign with Easel for Spring Summer Fall Winter Home Decoration Tier Tray Sign
features: INTERCHANGEABLE FARMHOUSE ROUND SHIPLAP SIGN: Each set of Houmury wooden tier Home decor farmhouse sign includes alternative Home sweet home sign & 4 season signs with 2 easels for farmhouse decor.

SAY "HELLO" TO EACH SEASON: The design of Houmury season signs is aim to add a sense of expectation to life, and they are the perfect way to usher in the change of seasons, when you are looking forward to warmer or colder weather.

ADD VARIETY TO THE PASSAGE OF TIME: different seasons are accompanied by different beauty, spring is splendid flower, summer is colorful popsicle, fall is orange pumpkin, winter is white snow. The bigger sign is decor with bowknot & lamb ear leaves for adding natural rural flavor.

1 LARGE & 1 SMALL EASEL: The large easel is 6.3*3.5" (16*9 cm)，the small easel is 3.5*2.4 (9*6 cm). The large roundwood sign is 8.8" (22.5*22.5 cm), the small roundwood sign is 4.7"*4.7" (12*12 cm). All the signs and easels can be easily assembled according to different needs.
GREAT ADDITION FOR YOUR HOME: Perfect to decorate your farmhouse kitchen, dining room table, entryway, entry table & tier tray, you will smile every time when you see it.
